body:
Track 1 follow-up to `selfrep-satmarket`: derives the Pontryagin singular arc (goods output grows linearly at rate kc; last 1/k hours all goods) and checks it against the DP policy. In the Euler model it earns 99.96–100.00% of the DP policy's value across 7 market sizes and 4 failure shares. Necessary conditions only; stylised; all inputs assumed. 8 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Duplicate-branch note: `claude/trusting-knuth-mc9kqj`, `claude/ecstatic-lamport-rinikt` (selfrep-rodbeam, already on main), `claude/sleepy-shannon-ck1uzg` (ambient-crossfit, already on main) and `claude/simdesign-gaugepockets` (same idea as simdesign-pocketmesh on main) are superseded and have no PRs.
